chunks: ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl ibn Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar—and he was the eldest shaykh among the descendants of Rasūl Allāh صلى الله عليه وآله in al-ʿIrāq—so he said:
I saw him between the two masjids, and he عليه السلام was a boy.

key_terms.أَسَنَّ شَيْخٍ: the eldest shaykh; describing the narrator’s seniority
key_terms.الْمَسْجِدَيْنِ: the two masjids; the location of the sighting
key_terms.رَأَيْتُهُ: I saw him; a direct eyewitness statement
key_terms.وُلْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: the descendants of Rasūl Allāh صلى الله عليه وآله

ai.seo_question: Who reported seeing him عليه السلام between the two masjids while he was still a boy?
ai.summary: This report records a witness statement from Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl ibn Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar about having seen him عليه السلام between the two masjids while he was still a boy. The narration serves as a biographical and historical testimony concerning one of those who saw him عليه السلام.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Muhammad, 
(It has been narrated) from Muhammad Bin Ismail Bin Musa Bin Ja’far, and he was the most aged Sheykhs from the children of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> in Al-Iraq. So he said,
‘I saw him<sup>asws</sup> between the two Masjids and he<sup>asws</sup> was a boy’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from Muhammad ibn ’Isma‘il ibn Musa ibn Ja‘far, the most senior (in his time) of the descendants of the Messenger of Allah, in Iraq has said the following.
“I saw him (the twelfth Imam (a.s.)) between the two mosque while he was a boy.”
